title: Technology Sector Update for 01/02/2019: BOX,MSFT,AKAM,SFET,GOOG,GOOGL
text:
Shutterstock photo Top Tech Stocks
MSFT -1.01%
AAPL -0.49%
IBM +0.91%
CSCO -1.41%
GOOG +0.39%
Technology stocks were moderately lower this afternoon, paring their steep descent earlier Wednesday, with the shares of tech stocks in the S&P 500 losing almost 0.4% in value while the Philadelphia Semiconductor Index was rising nearly 0.6% in recent trade.
Among technology stocks moving on news:
(+) Box Inc. ( BOX ) was just off its session high, rising over 8% in late trade, following renewed takeover speculation for the cloud content management platform. TheDeal.com, citing a D.A. Davidson research note last week naming Box among its most likely buyout targets for private-equity firms this year, was helping fuel Wednesday's run up, while Twitter chatter was focusing on Microsoft as a likely suitor.
In other sector news:
(+) Safe-T ( SFET ) climbed as much as 9% during Wednesday trading after the cyber-security company said it has received orders from its first customers in Cyprus and Serbia.
(+) Alphabet (GOOG,GOOGL) was 1% higher this afternoon, overcoming a decline earlier in the session after Reuters reported the internet conglomerate received approval from the US Federal Communications Commission to deploy its radar-based motion sensing device known as Project Soli.
(-) Akamai Technologies ( AKAM ) fell to the lowest in more than a year on Wednesday, sliding nearly 6% to $57.53, before coming off that low, after Cowen lowered its investment rating on the cloud services company to market perform from outperform.
